ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-Setup.exe](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.1.0/ChurchStream-Setup.exe)** (installer, recommended) · or [ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.1.0/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip) (no installer, e.g. for a USB stick) |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.1.0/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.1.0/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

The other files on this page (`ChurchStream-app-…`, `ffmpeg-…`, `update.json`) are for ChurchStream's own updates; you don't need to download them.

**Already on 1.0.0?** Click **Update** on the card in the control panel: only a few MB are downloaded.

## New in 1.1.0

Everything in the order of service can now be edited.

### Edit any item
- Hover a card in the order of service and click the **pencil**, or open the item and click **Edit**. (Both are hidden in volunteer mode.)
- **Slides** (PowerPoint, PDF or pictures): rename them, move slides earlier or later, remove some, add more from another file, and change how often they move on by themselves.
- **Bible readings:** change the passage or the translation, with a preview before you save.
- **Video, music and YouTube:** rename, repeat until stopped, and whether the sound also plays through the computer for the room.
- Songs, text, responsive readings and countdowns are edited as before.
- If the item is on the screens when you save, the screens update straight away.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
